column1: # Rule: what a node of the compiled format keeps of a value v, by its format (flags bits 4-5).
# 8 bits (0x09): fine = round(v 65535) >> 4 (16 bits to the nearest, cut to 12), out = (255 fine + 2047) >> 12 (a tie goes
# down: 0.5 gives 127). v is limited to 0..1 first.
# 16 bits (0x19): fine = floor(v 2^20), out = (65535 fine + 2^19 - 1) >> 20; v limited to 0..1 first.
# Half float (0x29): v cut to half precision towards zero, not rounded; below 2^-14 in steps of 2^-24; at 65536 and above,
# and NaN or infinite, unchanged. Negative values cut the same way towards zero (assumed, not measured).
# Source: measurement "Node formats" (8 bits), "Fx-map frames, draw order and small rules" > "Images" (8 bits),
# "One-effect projects" > "What nodes hold and how they read" (16 bits, half float).
# Columns: value = v (as f32); level_8 = k of k/255; level_16 = k of k/65535; half = the half-float node's value (as f32).
